channel.description: 'My Catalog' uses the IBM Cloud catalog API to retrieve data from the catalog. It attempts to be as accurate as possible. This feed shows additions, updates, removals from the catalog. Use with care. It is a work-in-progress :)

item.title: [updated] Secrets Manager (secrets-manager) has a new plan named dedicated
item.description:
Pricing consists of:
1. **Enterprise Vault Installation** for deployment instance and entitlements 2. **Resource Units (RUs)** that measure monthly secrets usage across
RUs provide a unified way to track usage for features such as static and dynamic secrets, PKI certificates and SSH credentials. Select the number of Resource Units needed for your expected workload.
For details on RU calculations, sizing guidance, and pricing examples, see the documentation.
